description: The testing phase: the full check on the dev server at phone, tablet and desktop sizes (Chromium and WebKit), the accessibility audit of / and /app, then, only after the person says yes to stopping the dev server, the production build, OFFLINE=1 site.mjs, perf-check and the Lighthouse measurement written to docs/testing/performance.md. Depends on FEAT-001 to FEAT-004.
steps: Plan step 27: dev-server check; from packages/web with BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000: site.mjs, axe.mjs, keyboard.mjs, switch.mjs, spell.mjs, responsive.mjs (Chromium), then ENGINE=webkit responsive.mjs and site.mjs; from the root pnpm -r typecheck, pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run, node scripts/tm-lint.mjs <every file changed in this task>, node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs, node scripts/check-kiro-not-ignored.mjs. Write every command and its result to /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life/.agents/tasks/marketing-landing/verification.md. Fix failures in the code they point at (re-run the failing command after each fix).

Plan step 28: accessibility audit of http://localhost:3000/ and http://localhost:3000/app with the a11y-auditor agent (or, if it cannot be dispatched, its method with the Playwright MCP: keyboard only, 200% and 400% zoom, Day theme, reduced motion and motion on); report under docs/a11y/; fix serious findings, record the rest in the report and verification.md.

Plan step 29: call send_message severity 'warning': Lighthouse needs a production build; ask whether the agent may stop the dev server on :3000 or the person will. Wait for the answer; do nothing that builds before it.

Plan step 30: after the yes: stop the dev server; `pnpm -F @ninth/web build`; start `pnpm -F @ninth/web exec next start -p 3202` in the background; from packages/web `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3202 OFFLINE=1 node test/e2e/site.mjs`; from the root `node scripts/perf-check.mjs --runs 3` and `node scripts/lighthouse.mjs --write`; stop next start; restart `pnpm dev` only on the person's word. Record the mobile medians (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO), desktop scores, and the page and worker byte lines in verification.md (the script writes docs/testing/performance.md). If a target or budget is missed, say so plainly to the parent with the numbers.
Plan step 31: tick tasks 26-28 and any remaining boxes in .kiro/specs/marketing-site/tasks.md; KIRO_LOG row for this session.
acceptance_criteria: verification.md lists every command of plan step 27 with a pass result
An accessibility report for / and /app exists under docs/a11y/ with no open serious or critical finding
docs/testing/performance.md holds the Lighthouse block (version, preset, URL, date, commit, three runs, medians, budgets) between the lighthouse markers
No build ran while the dev server was running
verification: cd packages/web && BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs (and axe, keyboard, switch, spell, responsive; ENGINE=webkit responsive and site)
node scripts/lighthouse.mjs --write (against next start on :3202, after the yes)
findings: All commands and results are in .agents/tasks/marketing-landing/verification.md; nothing committed. Step 27 on the dev server :3000 passed with no fixes: site.mjs 201 ok (Chromium) and 189 ok (WebKit), axe 40, keyboard 18, switch 5, spell 17, responsive 181 in each engine; pnpm -r typecheck; web tests 30 files / 334; tm-lint clean on the 94 changed files (92 scanned; marketing/demo-video/ excluded as other work); validate-kiro-config ok; check-kiro-not-ignored ok. Step 28: the a11y-auditor could not be dispatched from the step, so I followed its method with the Playwright MCP (keyboard only, 640x400 = 200% zoom, 320x200 = 400% zoom, Day theme, reduced motion and motion on). Report docs/a11y/2026-11-10-landing-and-app.md, screenshots docs/a11y/screens/site-* and app-*. No blocker, serious or moderate finding. Two minor findings, not fixed: (1) the inline 'Open an issue on GitHub' link in Access.tsx is 22px tall (WCAG 2.5.8 exempts inline links; moving it into .site-links is a content decision); (2) FAQ summary focus rings are cut off by up to 4px at the viewport bottom after a Tab scroll (fix: scroll-margin-block on focusables). The dev overlay's nextjs-portal is a Tab stop in dev only. /app Day theme by hand was not possible because saved settings reset to Night; axe covers it. Steps 29-30: the parent session stopped the dev server; build passed (/ 117 kB and /app 146 kB First Load JS); next start on :3202. Two TOOLING FIXES (no page change): (a) site.mjs OFFLINE runs failed twice (ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED) because they went offline after /app was cached but before the worker controlled the page; the run now waits for navigator.serviceWorker.controller and checks it ('the service worker controls the page before going offline (MS-2.4)'); the rerun passed. (b) lighthouse.mjs exited 1 with 'LCP element unknown' because Lighthouse 13 has no largest-contentful-paint-element audit; lcpElementTag in scripts/lighthouse-lib.mjs now reads lcp-breakdown-insight first and falls back to the old audit; new MS-11.2 case in lighthouse-lib.test.ts (web tests now 335). Lighthouse 13.6.0 medians, mobile and desktop: Performance 100, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100; mobile FCP/LCP 1,052 ms, desktop 282 ms, TBT 0, CLS 0, LCP element p. Mobile bytes: script 116.8/125 KB, CSS 8.0/16, document 17.6/32, font 51.1/60, image 4.4/16, total 199.4/250 KB; worker 2 requests 0.7 KB; no other origins. No target or budget missed. perf-check --runs 3: first load 538 KB (< 700), desktop parse 17.2 ms (< 100), offline reload 3 of 3 (182 ms), precache 29 entries at most 568 KB, first visit with the worker 636 KB. The block in performance.md names commit e8e3331, but the measured tree was uncommitted on top of it; re-run after the commit if the exact commit matters. The prebuild regenerated tokens.css (same generator, so no diff is expected). next start on :3202 is stopped; pnpm dev was NOT restarted (the person restarts it for the review steps). Ticked marketing-site tasks 21 (done in FEAT-001 step 8), 26, 27, 28; KIRO_LOG row added (2026-11-10, 'Kiro (marketing-landing workflow, FEAT-005)').
